chapter: Famous Door, the union dispute and Stuff Smith's last years
title: Stuff arrives late for the coast-to-coast NBC broadcast
summary: Stuff and his bassist were at a ball game while the band went on air without them; Stuff arrived five minutes before the end in riding clothes.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: you're dogging him, you know? Even I couldn't say nothing. I used to call him names. He'd get up on the stand and he'd make you mad. Here we are on the bandstand at 6:00 o'clock. We were supposed to play from 6:00 to 7:00 for the dinner hour, and come back from 9:00 to 1:00. Now, it happens that a certain night in the week, when you go on at 6:00 o'clock, you're on the air, too, NBC, coast to coast. Now, we get in there and get ready to hit, and everybody'd say, "Where's Stuff and John," [Brown] the bass player, "and Stuff." Don't know, you know. So the the announcer, he don't know from nothing, so we just go into it. It was lucky we had George Clark on tenor at this time, you know, we had added a tenor. And so the man gets up there and says, "And Stuff Smith and his Onyx Club boys, coming from the La Salle Hotel, the Blue Fountain Room." So we'd get up there (Singing) -- played on the trumpet. And then we'd start playing the numbers we've got and I'd keep telling the man I can't play the arrangements we've got, so I have to tell the man, I whisper to him while the tenor playing is playing I tell him what the next number is, you know. Because they liked for you to write it down so they can have it in front of them. But by him not being there. And finally, just about five minutes before we'd go off, here comes Stuff. And I'd say, "Where in the hell have you been," you know, "Man, we're on the air and everything, coast to coast." He'd say, "We got hung up in that traffic. We was at the ball game. And John got stuck too."

And I said, 'Why did you take John?' He said, 'Well, John was with me. I didn't think we were going to stay that long. I didn't think the game was going to run that long. So we stayed there and saw the game and I thought I could make it,' because he always drove fast, you know, but that traffic had him, you know, he couldn't move. And he come in there just like nothing had happened. Okay. Let's take it. After the broadcast we all got it now. Said, 'you all let him take it out.' And they wasn't even dressed or had their uniform on or nothing. He had on a riding habit, you know, and a green shirt and khaki riding pants and boots on, back in them days. It's all right today, but back in them days, he had boots on. He was way ahead of everybody. Now it'd make you so mad, but it didn't do you any good, so you just threw it out of your mind, you know, and you went on. And you know, you took it as it come, you know.
